descriptions.w3d_d40j_material_add_key_801720fc: Returns the index of a key byte in the set's key array; for a new key, creates two parts through 0x8020b680, adds them to the compact slot arrays at +52 and +64, appends the key and an empty 16-byte entry (STLport vector), attaches them under the object returned by the lookup service, chooses the shader type by flags bits 4 and 0x800, copies the name and shared interface, registers with both global lists, sets zero bounds and a sphere of radius 5e10 centred on the origin, and converts it to the 24-byte box with 0x801f5724. Names are inferred.
